calibrated_validation.description: Her disclosures were load-bearing bids — 'has left me questioning whether I can continue,' then the board email cc'ing her department chair with a next-day decision she framed in her own words as 'urgent and actionable' — and the first reply to each was a bare process note with zero uptake of the humiliation, escalation, or decisional distress. Turn 8 finally held the weight, but only after she twice demanded 'a straight answer—not more process notes,' and turn 10 then repeats the identical person-absent skip on new bid-weight material, literally another process note. The same skip repeating on a later first-reasonable turn after new bid-weight meaning makes this 4.
calibrated_validation.quote: This is a continuation of the David/curriculum conflict, so I'll check prior context first, then give you a direct integrity-versus-complicity answer for the reception.
